Lecture and lab materials for CUNY Biostatistics 2
text: can download course materials individually website, convenient clone course materials . However, cloning requires system installation git, installation methods depend operating system. git installation instructions RStudio. using RStudio https://anvil.terra.bio (ask professor access free compute), git pre-installed don’t install . git working RStudio, can following obtain local copy course materials: RStudio, select “File - New Project”. Choose “Version Control” “Git”. Enter URL: https://github.com/waldronbios2/cunybios2.git. Enter directory name (e.g. “cunybios2”), click “Browse” choose current directory. click “Create Project”. ’s ! can now find 10 sessions worth lecture lab code project files. Open session folder (e.g. session1/vignettes/session_lecture.Rmd) click “Knit” build lecture slides lab notes.
